verdict.rationale: Trello has no evidenced native AI Q&A over workspace content; its documented AI feature only helps write or edit content. The closest path is the MCP server ('Connect Trello to any AI tool'), which, together with the REST Search API, could let an external AI assistant query board content, but only by bringing in an outside tool. Missing for 10: a native in-product AI question-answering feature, answers with citations linking back to cards or boards, any evidence of instant workspace-wide answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
